note: FROZEN BEFORE dose unblinding (H-DOSE-CTR). Estimated on ORIGINAL programs only; no mutant realizations enter this file.
eps_tol_field_resolution: mr_export JSON has no eps_tol field; values taken from aligned R_mp numeric thresholds (see per-curve eps_tol_source).

curves.eps_tol_source: src/p2/mrs/a1.py R_mp1 uses guard abs(y+y')<1e6 (not a continuous violation scale). Direct functional V = mean |y_mut(x)-y_orig(x)| on PROBE_X; eps_tol:=1.0 is the unit of that functional (normalized detection scale; matches power_report 'eps_tol normalised 1.0').
curves.method_delta_r: A1-CE: Delta_r:=0 under F-10 functional V=mean|y_mut-y_orig| (original vs itself); R_mp1 guard 1e6 is not used as residual
curves.method_eta_bar: deterministic ODE: max(std of 5 repeats at x=0.5, AVP eps 1e-6); observed_std=0.000e+00
curves.method_notes: window_halfwidth = delta_r + 2*eta_bar; estimated on ORIGINAL program only (no mutants); freeze_seed=20260728

curves.eps_tol_source: src/p2/mrs/b3.py R_mp1: abs(abs(y_new-y_orig)-0.1) < 0.02 → continuous tol 0.02 on the linearity residual.
curves.method_delta_r: linearity residual of original MC estimator (fixed seed samples → exact linearity ⇒ ~0)
curves.method_notes: window_halfwidth = delta_r + 2*eta_bar; estimated on ORIGINAL program only (no mutants); freeze_seed=20260728

curves.eps_tol_source: src/p2/mrs/c1.py R_mp1: abs(y+y') < 0.1 → tol 0.1 on anti-symmetry residual.
curves.method_delta_r: anti-symmetry residual of original GPR on PROBE_X
curves.method_eta_bar: deterministic-kernel: max(std of 20 repeats at x=0.5, AVP eps 1e-6); observed_std=0.000e+00
curves.method_notes: window_halfwidth = delta_r + 2*eta_bar; estimated on ORIGINAL program only (no mutants); freeze_seed=20260728

curves.eps_tol_source: src/p2/mrs/d3.py R_mp1 is a hard bound y in [0,1] (no continuous tol). Surrogate soft margin 0.05 matches MP2/MP5 slack in the same module; functional V = mean |bias| = mean |p_mut - p_orig|.
curves.method_eta_bar: deterministic-kernel: max(std of 20 repeats at x=0.5, AVP eps 1e-6); observed_std=2.220e-16
curves.method_notes: window_halfwidth = delta_r + 2*eta_bar; estimated on ORIGINAL program only (no mutants); freeze_seed=20260728

curves.eps_tol_source: src/p2/mrs/a1.py R_mp3 is an attractor-envelope predicate (bound 60), not a continuous accuracy tol. Direct functional V = mean |y_loose(x)-y_ref(x)| / (1+|y_ref|) vs high-fidelity ref; eps_tol:=1.0 (normalized detection scale).
curves.method_delta_r: relative error of original vs itself = 0; Delta_r:=0 (RK45 rtol=1e-8 taken as ref)

curves.method_notes: window_halfwidth = delta_r + 2*eta_bar; estimated on ORIGINAL program only (no mutants); freeze_seed=20260728

curves.eps_tol_source: src/p2/mrs/b3.py R_mp3 envelope slack 0.05 around analytic integral.
curves.method_notes: window_halfwidth = delta_r + 2*eta_bar; estimated on ORIGINAL program only (no mutants); freeze_seed=20260728
